# HTML writing format

<!-- Generated by kition-sdk tools/writing-format.mjs from the HTML engine 0.1.0 and agent/guide.md. Regenerate it; do not edit it by hand. -->

What a model or a script writes to make or change an HTML document: the run syntax, every
command and its parameters, the value lists and the defaults the engine states, and worked examples.
It is made from the command catalogue of the HTML engine 0.1.0. Read
[`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md) first: it says how to address things, the workflow, and the
pitfalls.

## Syntax

Changes are steps of `html_run`; each step is one command with its parameters as JSON:

```json
html_run { "path": "<file>", "steps": [{ "command": "<command id>", "params": { … } }] }
```

A run is one step in the document's history. `html_commands` finds commands by words; the
lists below are the whole catalogue. A parameter marked required must be given; a parameter left out
takes the engine's default (listed where the engine states one). Commands marked (reads) answer
without changing the document.

## Value lists

No command takes a fixed list of values.

## Defaults

No schema states a default; the parameter descriptions name the defaults that exist.

## Commands

5 commands, by menu.

### Edit

- `file.setSource` (writes): Replaces the whole page with `source` (an HTML document, at most 1 MiB) as one undo step; answers `changed: false` when the source is already the same. The only way to edit the page.
  - `source` string
- `edit.undo` (writes): Puts back the source as it was before the last `file.setSource`. No parameters.
- `edit.redo` (writes): Applies again the `file.setSource` the last undo took back. No parameters.

### (no menu)

- `preview.click` (reads): Clicks the rendered page at `x`, `y` (CSS pixels from the page's top-left) so its scripts react, without changing the saved source; answers whether the rendered page changed.
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `preview.advance` (reads): Runs the page's timers and animations forward by `millis` milliseconds (a whole number), without changing the saved source; answers whether the rendered page changed.
  - `millis` integer

## Examples

From [`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md).

### Example 1: add a link under the date

```json
html_inspect {"path": "index.html"}
→ details.source: "<!doctype html>…<div class=\"card\"><p>Saturday 8 pm, Town Hall</p></div></body></html>\n"
html_run {"path": "index.html", "steps": [{"command": "file.setSource", "params": {"source":
  "<!doctype html>…<div class=\"card\"><p>Saturday 8 pm, Town Hall</p><p><a href=\"tickets.html\">Tickets</a></p></div></body></html>\n"}}]}
html_check {"path": "index.html"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```

(`…` stands for the unchanged rest of the source, which you send in full.)

### Example 2: fixing what the check finds

```json
html_check {"path": "poster.html"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "html.resource-unavailable", "severity": "error",
    "message": "The page asks for `images/poster.png`, which the kit cannot load, so it is missing."}]}
```

The kit does not load linked files, even ones in the workspace, so replace the image with a drawn
placeholder (or the picture as a `data:` URL):

```json
html_run {"path": "poster.html", "steps": [{"command": "file.setSource", "params": {"source":
  "…<div style=\"width:120px;height:80px;background:#5645d4\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Poster\"></div></body></html>\n"}}]}
html_check {"path": "poster.html"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```

A script error names the line:

```json
html_check {"path": "title.html"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "html.javascript-error", "severity": "error",
    "message": "Uncaught JS error in <inline script>: ReferenceError: missingTitle is not defined (unknown at :1:23)."}]}
```

Define the value or replace `missingTitle` with the text (`"Spring concert 2026"`) in the script,
send the whole source with `file.setSource`, and check again: `{"diagnostics": []}`.
